_comment: Config for H100 40GB nerf_ds dataset, NO masks (ignore_mask=true, forces the Otsu motion-threshold freeze_background_motion even though mask/ and resized_mask/ exist on disk). dyn_select_iter moved to AFTER the last anchor_refine_iters entry (finest anchor resolution) instead of staying between refines like configs_nerf_ds_with_mask.json: without mask supervision the Otsu split needs the cleanest motion signal available, which only exists once anchors are at their finest level. nerf_ds's largest scenes (bell/cup ~850-880 exemplars) are in the same ballpark as hypernerf's worst case (~1734 frames), so this mirrors configs_hypernerf.json's reasoning. iterations/anchor_stride/knn_k left at their pre-H100 values: nerf_ds's native 480x270 resolution is far cheaper per-iteration than hypernerf or dnerf (800x800), so the existing 40000-iteration budget is expected to clear comfortably inside 2-3h on H100, but this has not been empirically timed -- validate with a short run and retune if it overshoots.
